note: Menu rebuilt into three named groups, section rhythm made structural, footer fine print cut, and the 1956 portraits re-paired with their testimonies. The tone system was the surprise: only 31 of 385 sections ever carried a .tone-* class, and the fallback rhythm in design-refinements paints every second section rgba(255,255,255,.012) — about 1.03:1 on near-black, present in the code and absent to the eye. The rhythm is now applied by nth-of-type so it reaches all 130 pages without touching markup, and an explicit tone class still wins.
